job_matches.title: Backend Developer
job_matches.reason: The candidate has direct experience with API design using FastAPI and building full-stack applications with robust backend components. Their use of Supabase, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB showcases familiarity with various database systems and cloud-related services.
job_matches.evidence: Matched skills include "api design" (FastAPI in 'TECHNICAL SKILLS' and 'BookYourShoot') and "cloud" (Supabase in 'TECHNICAL SKILLS').
job_matches.gap: The CV does not explicitly mention experience with designing or implementing microservices architectures.

missing_skills.why: Modern backend development heavily relies on containerization for consistent environments and CI/CD for automated deployment, which are crucial for professional workflows.
missing_skills.project_idea: Develop a simple user management REST API using FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Containerize both the API and the database using Docker Compose. Implement a basic CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions to automate testing and Docker image builds upon code pushes.
missing_skills.implementation:
Phase 1: Build a FastAPI CRUD API for user management with PostgreSQL integration.
Phase 2: Create a Dockerfile for the FastAPI application and a docker-compose.yml to orchestrate the API and PostgreSQL.
Phase 3: Set up GitHub Actions to run tests, build the Docker image, and push it to a container registry on successful merges.
Resources: https://docs.docker.com/get-started/, https://docs.github.com/en/actions, https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/
missing_skills.milestone_1: Basic FastAPI CRUD API with PostgreSQL connection.
missing_skills.milestone_2: Docker Compose setup for the API and database.
missing_skills.milestone_3: GitHub Actions pipeline for automated testing and image building.

Use Celery with Redis as a broker to offload image processing tasks (e.g., resizing, watermarking) to background workers. missing_skills.milestone_1: FastAPI endpoint for task submission to a Celery queue.
missing_skills.milestone_2: Celery worker for background image processing.
missing_skills.milestone_3: Redis caching for API responses or processed image metadata.

job_matches.title: Frontend Developer
job_matches.reason: The candidate demonstrates foundational web development skills through their personal website and basic JavaScript calculator. Their CV explicitly lists HTML and CSS, which are core requirements for frontend roles.
job_matches.evidence: matched_skills: ["css", "html"], PROJECTS: "Built my personal website using simple HTML."

missing_skills.why: React and TypeScript are fundamental technologies for modern frontend development, crucial for building complex, scalable user interfaces that are type-safe and maintainable.
missing_skills.project_idea: Develop a single-page application (SPA) that displays a list of products fetched from a mock API. Users should be able to filter products by category, search by name, and view product details, all built with a component-based architecture.
missing_skills.implementation:
Phase 1: Set up a new React project using Vite with TypeScript template. Create basic routing and a product listing page.
Phase 2: Implement product filtering by category and a search bar using React hooks and state management. Integrate a mock API (e.g., JSON-server or a simple local JSON file).
Phase 3: Add a product detail page, implement responsive design, and deploy the application to a static hosting service like Netlify or Vercel.
Resources: https://react.dev/learn, https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/
missing_skills.milestone_1: Basic React/TypeScript project setup with a static product list display.
missing_skills.milestone_2: Functional filtering and search implemented, fetching data from a mock API.
missing_skills.milestone_3: Complete responsive UI, product detail view, and deployment to a live URL.

missing_skills.why: Demonstrates the ability to write robust, maintainable code and ensure application quality, which is a key skill for professional frontend roles and reduces bugs in production.
missing_skills.project: E-commerce Checkout Flow with End-to-End Tests
missing_skills.project_idea: Create a simplified e-commerce checkout process (e.g., add item to cart, proceed to checkout, fill form, confirm order). Implement comprehensive end-to-end tests using Playwright to simulate user interactions and validate the entire flow.
missing_skills.implementation:
Phase 1: Build a simple HTML/CSS/JavaScript application for a basic product page and a multi-step checkout form.
Phase 2: Set up Playwright in the project. Write initial E2E tests for navigating to the product page and adding an item to the cart.
Phase 3: Develop E2E tests for the entire checkout flow, including form submission, validation, and order confirmation. Run tests in different browsers.
Resources: https://playwright.dev/docs/intro, https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide
missing_skills.milestone_2: Playwright setup and initial tests for product selection.
missing_skills.milestone_3: Full E2E test suite for the checkout process, running successfully across browsers.
